[IARC.12.5] **Two consumers.** An integrator restoring the cache from
write-through persistence on startup ([NSTG.9] / [LSTO.4.5.2]), and the
`.dstest` interpreter applying an `initial: cache "k": v` arrange ([RTIM.14.4] /
[LTSL.5.2] / [RLOW.17.1]). The interpreter parses the seed's JSON text to a tree
once, at setup, then calls the primitive.
